subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class V

source.read: NCERT, Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage (2017), English section, read through a copy hosted by the Indian Education Repository (CPR India); CBSE circular 05/2019 asks schools to use it; Class V list
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A copy of the NCERT document, read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The class books have since changed (Mridang for Classes 1-2, Santoor for 3-5, Poorvi for 6-8, under NCF-SE 2023); their chapters are not listed here and a school may order or extend these outcomes.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.

outcomes.text: Answers questions on daily life and on unfamiliar stories and poems.
Shares songs, poems, riddles, stories and tongue twisters.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads storybooks, news and advertisements alone, then talks or writes about them.
outcomes.note: The suggested books are published works and are not in the app. The learner reads one and tells a grown-up about it; the app's own stories are in Reading.

outcomes.text: Reads for details and the order of events.
Links ideas worked out from a text to own experience.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Reads signs and public notices and answers questions on them.
